artifacts.title: Review: Deleting an unknown todo removes the last one
artifacts.markdown:
Approved. `TodoStore.remove` now returns false before calling `splice` when `findIndex` gives -1, so an unknown id no longer deletes the last todo. `server.ts` already maps false to 404. Tests cover the unknown id (returns false, list unchanged) and removal of only the target when two todos exist.

No blocking issues.

Minor, optional: there is no server-level DELETE test. The plan marked it optional, and the store test covers the root cause.

payload.text:
I approved the ticket. `TodoStore.remove` now returns false before calling `splice` when the id isn't found, so an unknown id no longer deletes the last todo. The server already maps false to 404, so it needed no change. I didn't run the tests or the linter; QA runs the tests.

The branch adds two tests in `test/todos.test.ts`. One checks that removing an unknown id returns false and leaves the list unchanged. The other changes "remove deletes the todo" to use two todos and check that only the target is removed.

There is no server-level test for `DELETE /api/todos/999`. The plan marked it optional and the store test covers the root cause, so I didn't ask for it.

EV0XEBCZ-2 and EV0XEBCZ-3 also edit `src/todos.ts` and `test/todos.test.ts`, so I recorded both as low-severity overlap warnings. EV0XEBCZ-3 adds `rename` right above `remove`, so that merge may need a trivial conflict resolution. EV0XEBCZ-2 changes other parts of the same files.
